# Delivery protocol (`git push`)

- Push only after the user approved it in chat; never `main`, never `--force`
  (`AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/rules/git-commits.mdc`).
- Before the push: `make check` green; one commit per plan task (`type: summary`).
- After the push: `gh pr create` with a `type: summary` title (never draft or WIP), then
  `gh pr edit <n> --add-assignee Pawlo77 --add-label <enhancement|bug|documentation>`.
- Watch CI: `gh run list --branch "$(git branch --show-current)" --limit 5`, then
  `gh run watch <run-id> --exit-status` for Prek Checks, Pytest, CodeQL and PR title
  (the required `title` check); fix red runs with a follow-up commit on the same branch.
- After merge: tick the plan checkboxes, write `/remember`, and the compounding step of
  skill `vibe` (a `knowledge/handbook/Solutions/` note).
